subject: Re: MPL kickoff — Q3 proposal decision
body:
Team,

Decision on the 04-27 proposal, made with Santiago this morning:

1) Q3 scaled run is scoped to two internal low-label datasets, not three. At Umar's measured 1.4x cost profile, two datasets fit the $120k earmarked for us on line B-88 with ~15% rerun headroom; three would leave zero margin, and this quarter taught us that margin is not optional with a teacher-student loop.
2) Chiara's checkpoint-cadence fix is mandatory for all Q3 runs — it's worth roughly $9k of recovered preemption waste on its own.
3) The third dataset (the long-tail retail one) becomes first in line if headroom materializes late in Q3.

Idris — proposal doc with these numbers is in your inbox for the planning cycle; grateful for a confirm-in-writing when the Q3 books open.

Strong quarter, everyone. Both benchmarks reproduced and an honest cost model — exactly what the scaled run needed.

Lucia
